findings.session_summary: Initial mentoring session focused on establishing a practical homework support plan. The student identified difficulty finishing tasks due to uncertainty about teacher acceptance of late work. A specific activity was completed in-session: creating a simple list of current tasks and due dates, which the student found useful for visualizing options. An external request (checking school policy/teacher availability) remains pending.
findings.primary_concern: Student starts homework but rarely finishes everything; uncertainty regarding teacher acceptance of late submissions hinders planning.

tracked_details.detail: Agreed between-session task: Check two deadlines and bring confirmed dates to the next meeting.
External support inquiry: Verify which teacher accepts late submissions or check school policy regarding deadlines.

next_steps: Student to attempt checking two deadlines and recording confirmed dates.
Mentor and student to review the list of tasks and due dates at the next session.
Address pending external support request regarding teacher acceptance policies.
uncertainties: Whether external school support (policy check) will be approved or delivered.
Exact timing for checking deadlines before the next appointment.
findings.conclusion: The session successfully delivered a preparatory activity (task list creation) which the student found helpful. However, the intended external support (verifying teacher acceptance policies) has not been delivered yet and remains pending. The main barrier of uncertainty regarding task completion persists but is being managed through the agreed plan to check specific deadlines.

findings.session_summary: Follow-up session focused on reviewing a missed between-session task (checking deadlines) and practicing breaking down an urgent task into smaller steps. The student explicitly distinguished between the in-session activity (practicing steps) and external support delivery, noting that no external service was received yet.
findings.primary_concern: Uncertainty regarding teacher acceptance of late submissions and variable ability to complete homework due to home/school circumstances.
